overview: The Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities reviewed outcomes from their recent disability fair, discussed site selection and accessibility design for municipal playgrounds, and agreed to have Gabby serve as interim chair. The commission also approved prior meeting minutes and considered potential updates to its name and public outreach.

items.title: Introductions and Guest Welcome
items.summary: Commissioners introduced themselves and welcomed prospective member Cameron Knapp.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes for June and September.

items.title: Recap of Disability Fair and Mobile Vaccine Clinic
items.summary: The commission reviewed the recent disability fair, noting strong vendor networking but lower resident attendance, while discussing community feedback on speaker representation and clinic results where 23 flu and 53 COVID vaccines were administered.

items.title: Commission Name and Identity
items.summary: Members discussed updating the commission's name to improve clarity and public outreach, agreeing to hold further discussion in the new year.

items.title: Tufts T Station Accessibility Update
items.summary: Frances Nwajei reported that two accessible parking spots have been painted and resolved in front of the Tufts T station.

items.title: Inclusive Playgrounds and Carr Park
items.summary: Consultant Chenine Peloquin outlined accessibility and ADA standards for city playgrounds, prompting commission discussion on prioritizing sites near public transit rather than locations like Carr Park.

items.title: Commissioner Expectations and Regional Transit Meeting
items.summary: Frances Nwajei urged commissioners to attend an upcoming regional transit meeting regarding snow removal and reinforced member attendance responsibilities.

items.title: Interim Chair Selection
items.summary: Chair Tom Hamel announced he is stepping down due to personal commitments, and commissioners agreed without objection to have Gabby serve as interim chair.
